root_cause.text: In f2fs_fsync_node_pages for atomic files, set_dentry_mark was called before acquiring the node_write lock, allowing a concurrent checkpoint to write the node page and later set the IS_CHECKPOINTED flag after the dentry mark had already been set, causing a second write of the same node page and subsequent inconsistency after sudden power-off.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly shows the race scenario where Thread A sets dentry mark on the last folio after the checkpoint has written it but before the checkpoint sets the IS_CHECKPOINTED flag. The patch moves set_dentry_mark into __write_node_folio, which holds the node_write lock, ensuring synchronization with the checkpoint's NAT flush that sets IS_CHECKPOINTED. The patch diff confirms the removal of set_dentry_mark from f2fs_fsync_node_pages (for atomic case) and its addition inside __write_node_folio under an atomic condition.
